news.title: Poll shows virtual tie in Georgia governor’s race
news.summary: A new Atlanta Journal-Constitution poll shows Republican Rick Jackson and Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms are in a virtual dead heat.

news.title: Former sheriff says credit union denied $3.4K fraud claim after France pedicab ride
news.summary: A Rockdale County man says what was supposed to be a 30-euro pedicab ride in Paris turned into a $3,400 credit card charge and months of frustration after his fraud claims were repeatedly denied.

news.title: Police say man groped 3 women at metro shopping center in just 10 minutes
news.summary: Orlandus Sims was arrested in Cobb County after allegedly groping three women at three stores in just 10 minutes.

news.title: Police say thieves used a ladder to steal $8,000 from metro storage unit
news.summary: A man faces charges after thieves climbed into a Cobb County storage unit to steal TVs and sensitive personal documents.

news.title: Atlanta Technical College shooting: Student who died identified
news.summary: Authorities have identified a student who died following an accidental classroom shooting Monday morning at Atlanta Technical College as a 60-year-old man.

news.title: Atlanta officers use phone call to resolve armed standoff
news.summary: Atlanta police responded to a reported dispute involving a firearm Oct. 15 at a home on Ashby Terrace.

news.title: ATF offers $5K reward for man wanted in Bibb County fire
news.summary: The ATF is offering a $5,000 reward for information leading to Brandon Joshuah Mallory.

news.title: Henry County detention officer arrested on multiple felony charges involving allegations of misconduct
Fourth suspect in shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor near railway property charged
news.summary: Christopher S. Riles faces felony murder and aggravated assault charges, Cobb County Police said.
